dossier.headline: Asia's chip sell-off returns as the AI trade unwinds
dossier.summary: Asian chip stocks have swung hard on the AI trade, with Kospi sliding on 23 Nov and again on 25 Nov after Tuesday's Nvidia-led surge. On 25 Nov Indian shares rallied regardless, catching up with a global rally missed during Tuesday's holiday.
why_it_matters: Monday's Indian sell-off was linked partly to the global AI sell-off
India is bucking the regional trend on 25 Nov, so a deeper Asian slide is a test of that
